scope: Independent ARMv6-M binary64 sqrt and exp kernels. Current production ELF compared with 9efed4d4f and external Qfplib-M0-full by executed instruction count. No change to Cortex-M4.

sqrt.algorithm: Normalize to 1 <= m < 4. A midpoint quadratic estimates R=sqrt(m)*2^31 and V=2^31/sqrt(m). One three-partial-product Newton correction gives a 53-bit root estimate; its exact signed 106-bit square residual fits 64 bits and decides nearest rounding.
sqrt.bounds: Taylor remainders, coefficient rounding, Q24 coordinates and Q16 quadratic products bound |R-error| < 4.2 and |V-error| < 8. The first square residual fits 36 signed bits; dropping five bits fits int32. Omitted partial-product carries affect the root by less than 1/16 integer unit. Including nearest rounding, the root estimate is within 0.63 integer units, so one exact residual correction suffices. The loop also handles equality at the lower interval boundary.
sqrt.rounding: Nearest integer iff -q < radicand-q*q <= q. An integer radicand cannot equal (q+1/2)^2, so there are no ambiguous midpoint ties. All binary64 significand bits enter the final residual.
sqrt.coefficient_proof: Each of 3072 coefficient roundings is verified by exact rational square inequalities. Every Q16-block extremum is checked in the two upper-limit boundary segments, preventing root/inverse word overflow.
sqrt.excluded_relocation: Special-input fallback BL instruction at byte offsets 14..17; each linked fallback separately qualified.

exp.algorithm: Reduce by ln(2)/512 using a certified split Q96 constant and the full input significand. Compute exp(r)=1+r+r^2*(1/2+r/6+r^2/24) for |r|<0.000679. Q40 correction coefficients and bounded high-word products retain ten guard bits. A Q62 2^(j/512) table supplies the exponent segment; pack with one nearest-even rounding, including subnormals.
exp.bounds: The omitted fifth-order Taylor remainder is below 1.3e-18 on the reduced interval. Q40 coefficient and fixed-product errors remain below one binary64 ULP; observed worst error is 1 ULP. Every approximate 64x64 high-word product underestimates the exact high word by at most two integer units.
exp.constant_proof: All 512 table roundings are certified by raising their half-integer bounds to power 512. Rational lower/upper bounds from 100 positive terms of 2*atanh(1/3) certify ln(2)/512 and the Q31 reciprocal.
exp.compile_option: Function-local GCC optimize(Os); measured O3 expansion adds spills. Existing arithmetic compilation options remain unchanged.

implementation.ieee: Preserve nearest-even, subnormals, both zero signs for sqrt, signed NaN payload quieting, infinities and domain errors. Neither new normal kernel needs float arithmetic, an FPU or SIO division.
implementation.license: Independently derived project code and generated data; no Qfplib GPL code or tables copied into the firmware.

production_profile.oracle: sqrt: exact integer square inequalities; exp: Decimal precision 100; specials bitwise.
production_profile.abi: Every scalar call checks R4-R11/SP, bounded stack writes and pending SIO state.
production_profile.note: Executed ARM instructions, not RP2040 cycles or microseconds. Production ROM CLZ/memory intrinsics are functionally modeled by Machine.

arm_runtime.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
arm_runtime.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

portable_runtime.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack only
portable_runtime.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

production_math.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
production_math.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

addition_bytes_preserved.scope: Read-only byte comparison: subtraction entry and all addition fast paths in the production ELF exactly match the independently tested ARM binary. No ELF execution or external fallback relocation check is performed.

float_usage.purpose: Conversions are required by the APP conversion service and the math self-test; no resident float arithmetic remains.

manifest.board: ClockworkPi PicoCalc + Raspberry Pi Pico H

qfplib.scope: Separate external reference ELF. Profiled inputs and outputs are normal finite values; differing special-case IEEE semantics are not used for speed claims.

limits: Executed instruction counts are not RP2040 cycles or microseconds; hardware timing is pending. The device is disconnected and the user authorized continuing without it.
All seven normal stream means are below Qfplib, without claiming a universal per-input instruction ordering.

The binary64 significand space is not exhaustively enumerated. Exact sqrt error bounds are combined with directed and random actual-ARM checks; exp accuracy uses independent high-precision references.
Production SDK ROM CLZ/memory intrinsics are functionally modeled; their internal instruction costs are excluded by the common test harness.
This change targets sqrt(double) and exp(double); other transcendental functions and conversion routines have not been redesigned.
